pcs.pc_description: greet customers in a polite and friendly manner
communicate clearly with customers using verbal and non-verbal communication
show colour combinations, finish and texture/ design to the customer, using shade cards, texture/ design booklets
address customer queries and provide accurate information
review customer feedback for continuous improvement
identify customer’s painting service requirements and preferences for colour, texture/ design
plan the sequence of painting different areas of the premises, considering the customer’s preferences
note the customer’s concerns regarding the conduct of the painters during painting
note down the customer’s budget

modules.module_title: Estimate cost, materials, tools and equipment, and time required

pcs.pc_description: assess the type and condition of the substrate to be painted
select the most appropriate tool and equipment and method for measurement of the painting area eg. a scale or a tape for linear measurements
measure the painting area and calculate the quantity of material required using appropriate formula
estimate the manpower and time required for completing the painting job
identify the tools and equipment required, including PPE, for the job
estimate the total cost and mutually agree with the customer
discuss the completion date and payment schedule with the customer and document the same
prepare the final invoice and submit to the customer for payment, after completion of the job

pcs.pc_description: review the work instructions and plan to meet the required quality standards
inspect the work area, assess hazards and risks and apply controls, including required signage and barricades
identify materials, tools and equipment required, calculate quantities and locate ready for use
check the tools, equipment and hoses before use as per manufacturer’s recommendation
check the work site for provision of adequate ventilation and implement steps to prevent fires and explosions
test the condition and nature of the substrate and surface material by performing suitable tests
prepare the surface in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommendation, substrate and required quality
protect surrounding areas with drop cloths, masking or removing the objects
implement steps to maintain the application area dust free
mix the paint/ coating, ingredients, diluents in the recommended ratio, to achieve the specified consistency and drying
stir paint/ coating and colours thoroughly using separate stirring sticks or other devices
set up and test spray system equipment and accessories as per manufacturer’s recommendation

modules.module_title: Apply paint/ coating on the surface

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate brush or roller or brush/ roller combination or spray system or appropriate application method based on the surface profile, size of the area, type of paint /coating and finish
apply paint/ coating to achieve the required opacity/ colour, finish, texture and sheen
operate the spray equipment as per the SOP and manufacturer’s recommendation
identify defects in the coating and take corrective measures to achieve the required quality
clean up the workspace and place waste and discarded materials into appropriate waste bins or rubbish stock pile
clean the tools and equipment with appropriate solvents
dispose off paint/ coating waste, water and solvents used in cleaning the painting equipment, as per organization’s and local disposal norms
store tools, equipment and unused materials safely

modules.module_title: Identify potential market needs and business opportunities

pcs.pc_description: survey the local area for commercial and/ or residential projects to identify prospective customers
collect and analyze market information for potential opportunities
identify products and/ or services and it's sources, that match the business opportunity
identify customers for the products and/ or services
advertise and distribute pamphlets informing services offered
tie up with dealers and paint companies
receive word-of-mouth publicity to build customer and channel partner loyalties
enroll into various paint company’s brand loyalty programs and get certified
keep updated regarding new market trends to provide service to customers

pcs.pc_description: generate a final invoice for the services rendered and agreed
collect payment either in cash or through online/ UPI
maintain accounts for the material supplied, wages paid and payment collected
account for the taxes collected and paid into government treasury
maintain a monthly account to keep track of profit/ loss
comply with workplace health and safety rules stipulated by local authorities
comply with rules related to taxes and duties
comply with prevalent labour laws
